name: Spring Lab
desc: A driven mass-spring-damper: mass, stiffness, damping and drive sliders drive the natural frequency, damping ratio and resonance amplitude.
controls: Mass, stiffness, damping, drive-frequency and drive-amplitude sliders, five damping/resonance presets, play/pause, kick and reset; keys 1–5 load presets, Space pauses, K kicks, R resets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
